[[File:RRM.jpg|thumb|224px|Finis Valorum used a power-shovel for the Refugee Relief Movement's new structure on Alderaan.]]
A '''power-shovel''',<ref name="HNN49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_2.html|Alderaan Opens to Refugee Relief Movement}}</ref> also spelled '''power shovel''',<ref name="Otherspace">[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]</ref> was a tool used for digging. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] used a power-shovel to dig postholes on the plains of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where a prefabricated structure was to be installed for the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]].<ref name="HNN49" />
